source: Wikidata inception (P571, year precision or finer) on works with composer (P86). A century-like decade can still use the statement's start and end years. Several exact years within 30 years are stored as a range. IMSLP Year/Date of Composition comes from Wikidata P839 and from the composer's IMSLP category when the page names that composer. An existing catalogue key is not replaced. A set key is dropped when its numbered pieces do not share one date. Matched on catalogue numbers (a numbered span only when every number is dated), then a unique form or title. Premiere (P1191), publication (P577), and MusicBrainz first-release dates are not used. Open Opus does not provide a year.
